verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document Skyvern's own rules engine or event-triggered actions. The nearby features are adjacent rather than event rules: Copilot-built agents can be scheduled (a time-based recurring schedule), a per-run webhook_url sends one outbound POST when a run finishes, and a bare 'Connect to Zapier' mention leaves any event logic in an external tool. None of these lets a user define rules that fire actions automatically on events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
